# dr_wav

Unmodified `dr_wav.h` from https://github.com/mackron/dr_libs at commit
`d422edf14ec2b81ac40a7f22b5a7f64276b5fc34`.

License: public domain or MIT-0; full license text is retained at the end of the
header. Used only for Microsoft ADPCM (WAVE format 2), with memory input and
bounded decoded output. Existing PCM/IMA/CAF/AIFF/MP3/M4A paths are unchanged.
